declarations.description: Process-of-elimination tool for the item in its enclosing `<pie-item-scope>`: it adds a toggle to each choice an element supplies for `answer-masking` that strikes the choice through, crosses it out or masks it, per `strategy`. The toggle renders as the NDS icon button when the runtime context sets `ndsIcons`. It renders nothing of its own and is active while `visible` or `always-on` is set; `elementIds` limits the toggles to those elements' choices. Eliminations persist in the runtime context's element tool state store, under the key `elementStateKeys` gives each PIE element.
declarations.name: ToolAnswerEliminator

members.name: strategy
members.description: How an eliminated choice is painted: `strikethrough` strikes its text and crosses out its images and math, `cross` draws an X over block content and a line through inline content, and `mask` dims and blurs it.

members.name: elementStateKeys
members.description: Store key per PIE element, by model id (JS property only)

members.name: elementIds
members.description: Model ids of the PIE elements whose choices take a toggle. Unset, every element's choices do.

cssProperties.name: --pie-answer-eliminator-strike-color
cssProperties.description: Single colour for every part of an elimination: the text line-through, the diagonals over an image, and the line or diagonals over rendered math, so one choice reads as one treatment. Must fall back through canonical --pie-incorrect so a host that themes only the canonical feedback tokens still gets a coherent strike. Folds into --pie-incorrect by --pie-fixed-hue-collapse, so a colour scheme replaces a host strike colour and a Base Theme keeps it exactly.

cssProperties.name: --pie-tool-trigger-active-color
cssProperties.description: Component trigger active/open foreground hook; hosts are responsible for preserving contrast with the active trigger background.
